facts.text: The nearby stations disagree about this year: snow left Salmon Meadows (4,460 ft) 16 days earlier and Harts Pass (6,490 ft) 8 days later than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Salmon Meadows
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 3 (2023), April 19 (2024), April 19 (2025)

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: left June 14; earlier seasons: June 3 (2023), June 16 (2024), June 6 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Harts Pass (6,490 ft) and the lowest at Salmon Meadows (4,460 ft).
